provenance.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n): sorted sample 29 of 30

provenance.measurement_scope: three sequential fresh-process live decisions; bundle includes Python subprocess/capture bookkeeping; excludes fixture setup, source retrieval and hashing binaries
provenance.load: parent full gate may run concurrently; sequential debug/release blocks, each independently paired against Bash
